events.text: Manifested in the past.
Learned the year was 4669.
Awakened in a sewer pipe and were told to make level 2 characters.
Gained DUAL CLASS from the Rune Wheel.
Stated Carnon would be a Leshy Fighter / Animist.
Stated the character would be Fighter/champ.
Learned very little time would pass when in Riddleport.
Reached the start of the campaign.
Found themselves at the intersection of a sewer laying on piles of shit.
Were asked what happens next.
Connected mind to the runewheel to weave a being of his own design.
Named her Necrila, daughter of the chronicler.
Connected consciousness to the runewheel to consider who was needed.
Connected to the runewheel to consider who would be best.
Cardigan Green appeared beside the party as a bubble of green light.
Cardigan sat in the waste after the power was dispelled.
Sinhow stood up and asked for lights.
Necrila approached the group and asked where they were.
Sinhow asked Cardigan to lead the way out of the sewer.
Sinhow used Arcane Sense to cast detect magic.
Cardigan's Eldamon brought the party above ground.
Cardigan returned with a map bought for 10 GP.
The party gained a map granting a +1 item bonus to related checks.
Cardigan identified their location as the Leeward District.
Several prostitutes walked past the alleyway entrance.
The party saw a Wainwright, an open bakery, and a church of Sarenrae.
Sinhow entered the bakery.
Sinhow asked the baker about breads and pastries.
Cardigan looked sad at the state of the church.
The party left the bakery with a loaf of fancy bread.
Sinhow led the party toward the church and asked about back entrances.
The party found the 2 metre iron gate unlocked.
The party saw a large oak tree between the fence and the church.
Cardigan recalled climbing the tree with Boggly.
Sinhow walked to the church door and knocked.
Filiaur attempted to open the door but found it locked.
An elderly catfolk opened the door and demanded what they wanted.
Caroline introduced herself and asked if they wanted work.
Caroline told the group to follow her up the southern staircase.
Sinhow opened the hall door and counted the people inside.
The party saw sick and starved people cluttered along the hall.
A shadow-flesh little girl stared at the party.
Necrila asked if the girl was part of the priesthood.
The party saw an old stone well in the centre of the room.
Mika the Redeemer called for a blood sacrifice.
An attacker charged at Necrila with a serrated dagger.
Mika's red glowing eyes stopped glowing.
Mika stumbled backwards to the well.
Mika fell backwards into the well.
The well water turned to blood and Mika's body dissolved.
Sinhow inspected the bear and looked at the girl.
Sinhow suggested finding Necrilla on the roof.
Necrila dragged it into the sunlight.
The little building turned to ash.
Nothing was left on the roof.
A woman giggled briefly and then there was silence.
Necrila spoke to the sun and roared in triumph.
Necrila entered back into the building.
Sinhow looked around for Cardigan.
Sinhow asked Cardigan what she found out about the church.
Sinhow decided to find Necrilla and go up the ladder.
Sinhow asked about a walkway.
The group gathered on the roof.
The group prepared to go into the inner chapel.
The group pushed open the wooden doors.
The group entered a stone room with flaming braziers.
The group saw a priest praying with children and adults.
The group saw an acolyte watching them.
The priest invited the group to join the prayers.
Necrila rejoined the group and spoke to Cardigan.
Jhonas tensed and asked if the group worked with the group.
Jhonas whispered that wine was given to Father Patrick to keep him placated.
Father Patrick ended prayers and greeted the group.
Father Patrick remembered Cardigan as a name given by Yubis to a Gnomish baby.
Father Patrick welcomed the group to the temple of Sarenrae.
The group went back to the front hall.
The group went up the stairs.
The group arrived in a large hallway with corridors and doors.
The group saw the hallway floor covered in rubbish and mess.
Caroline introduced Knuckles the man and Fetch the dog.
Caroline told the group to follow her.
The group went down several corridors and stopped at numbered rooms.
Caroline took the group outside of room 9.
Caroline opened the door of room 9.
The group found Balston and Mad Rat inside room 9.
Balston asked what brought the group to the temple of Sarenrae.
Cardigan's Meese killed Balston with an addling blast.
Mad Rat dropped his daggers and claimed he was not with the gang.
Mad Rat said he worked for Avery Slyeg looking for Beltias Kreun.
Mad Rat said Beltias Kreun was plotting up in the Bell Tower.
Necrila killed Knuckles Redbone.
Knuckles Redbone and Fetch died.
Necrila chopped off Knuckles head.
Mad Rat said Brandy Nurrus and Garspheal Elstrice were in Room 12.
Mad Rat said Badeye Rumblefist and Rasper Ellias were in Room 13 with scorpions.
Sinhow ordered the group to head to Room 12.
Mad Rat pointed at the door labelled 12.
A gruff voice yelled from inside.
Brandy Nurrus opened the door.
Brandy Nurrus accused the group of not being cleaners.
Necrila beheaded a bandit.
Mad Rat killed the wood elf dead.
The group found a small box.
The box contained silver cutlery and a strange +1 spyglass.
Sinhow herded the party toward the door of Room 13.
The group walked up to door 13.
Two voices cheered on a cock fight inside.
Four monstrous dog-sized scorpions stood in a plank arena.
Rasper told the party to piss off.
Rasper Ellias asked Mad Rat if the boss needed them.
Filiaur messaged Sinhow suggesting waiting until the scorpion fight was over.
Rumble fist told the group to piss off.
Rasper agreed and tried to close the door.
Injured scorpions lay on straw beds in the corners of the room.
Necrila sang in Necril before combat.
Combat began.
Injured scorpions limped over to join the fight.
Two scorpions died.
Prof. Filiaur Bluestar was left near death.
Sinhow killed Badeye Rumblefist.
Yaseitori killed Rasper Ellias.
Combat ended.
18 HP was healed.
Yaseitori introduced himself and said he tracked a stolen necklace here.
Mad Rat listed the surviving gang members.
Filiaur proposed distracting Pidge to ambush him.
Moonshine stumbled out from around the corner.
Rax slipped inside through the ajar door.
The party opened the door and found a tied-up pirate woman.
Sinhow lowered the prisoner's gag and questioned her.
Moonshine tried to pick the prisoner's handcuffs.
Filiaur explained the ambush plan against Pidge.
Rax offered to hit Pidge with a Skunk Bomb.
The party made their way down the corridor.
Mad Rat opened the door to the cold pigeon room.
Hundreds of pigeons perched on the ceiling beam.
Pidge healed a baby pigeon and released it into the air.
Yaseitori stepped forward to protect Pidge.
Pidge walked into the portal and left.
Sinhow said the party would move towards the bell tower.
Mad Rat proposed going up the tower using stealth.
Sinhow suggested climbing the outside to cut the rope.
Moonshine produced a signal whistle.
Sinhow outlined the climb, cut, and whistle signal plan.
Moonshine prepared a climbing kit and repeated the plan.
The party left the temple.
The party reached the tower part of the structure.
The GM stated the tower was 30 metres tall.
Moonshine agreed to climb with Yaseitori.
Moonshine completed the climb to 100 feet.
Yaseitori completed the climb to 100 feet.
The climbers arrived on a stone platform before wooden doors.
The GM said the doors led to the upper bell tower.
Moonshine looked for a string to cut on the platform.
Cardigan wondered inside the temple about the bell tower.
Moonshine pushed the doors open to peer inside.
The party saw a massive metal bell.
The party saw spiral steps descending downstairs.
The GM asked what the party would do next.
Yaseitori headed inside and checked for someone hiding.
Found arcane runes scrawled upon the bell surface.
Identified the runes as manipulating primal earth energy.
Moonshine shrugged and suggested trying the bell.
Yaseitori walked toward the abseiling gear and suggested cutting it.
Suggested weakening the rope so it tore when used.
Moonshine took the device down the tower to the abseiling equipment.
Grabbed the device, went down the tower and rigged it to fall apart.
Yaseitori decided to wait on top.
Moonshine blew the signal whistle.
Necrila won initiative with 25.
Started combat encounter The Bell Tower of Beltias Kreun.
Stood outside the door to the spiral stairs room and opened the door.
Stood upon the platform of the bell tower in misty rain and gained the Rune-Wheel blessing.
Igarashi Enya ran away when her nerve broke.
Found a spiral staircase of grey stone behind the door in the same corridor.
Rax took the lead and checked the stairs for traps.
Cardigan and Rax climbed the stairs.
Moved everyone up the stairs at max speed.
Noted that checking for traps slowed movement.
A man ran up the stairs to the bell and was surprised to see Yaseitori.
Asked if everyone was running up again.
Calculated Cardigan reached 42.5 feet up the stairs.
Summarized Round 2 movement up the stairs and across Kreun room.
Yaseitori failed to demoralise Kreun and entered Tiger Stance with Hunt Prey.
Kreun used the sabotaged abseil device, the cord snapped, and he fell and grabbed an edge.
Rax hit Kreun with two skunk bombs for 2 damage.
Mad Rat hit with a crossbow strike for 4 damage.
Sinhow rushed down the stairs.
Filiaur's puppet grabbed Kreun.
GM posted Round 3 combat status for The Bell Tower of Beltias Kreun and waited for player responses.
GM asked about taking Mad Rat's turn.
Ryo noted Mad Rat had acted and Cardigan was awaited.
Sinhow yelled and rushed down the spiral stairs to ground level.
Cardigan moved down the main spiral stairs to the 2nd floor hallway near the bell-tower room.
GM reposted Round 3 combat status with unacted and acted lists.
GM noted waiting on four players.
Players discussed paused game and missing macros in OOC chatter.
Lenma sprinted down stairs to bottom near hallway entrance.
GM reported party positions across tower, stairs and hallway.
Beltias Kreun critically succeeded his second Escape attempt.
Beltias Kreun stood up after escaping.
Sinhow smashed through window and fell onto cobblestones outside.
Filiaur moved through corridor to edge of the window.
Party surrounded Kreun at ground level outside the temple.
Beltias Kreun strode north across temple grounds toward back gates.
Beltias Kreun surrendered and fell to his knees.
Rax treated Beltias wounds to keep him alive.
Saw fire rising on roof of temple
Learned corpses were being burned with last rites
Learned Mad Rat knew the way
Saw Kreun's ciphered papers and loot from bell tower
Watched Cardigan cry over priest's gift
Followed Mad Rat through Riddleport for about 10 minutes
Saw wilds of pirate city
Saw mid-day parties, fighting and crime
Stopped at small pawn shop to wait
Saw Mad Rat pop out minutes later
Learned Crimelord Cyrus wanted to see party with Beltias
Learned next stop was Silver Succubi night club
Neared Silver Succubus
Followed Mad Rat into wide plaza
Saw eight-foot succubus statue before doors
Learned Mr Cyrus ran legitimate business
Learned not to stare at Mr Cyrus's clockwork hand
Said party was ready to enter
Entered Silver Succubi through swinging doors
Walked through short entrance hallway
Met one-eyed orc Davy Crab-Basket
Learned Davy recognised Beltias
Passed through black stone double doors
Saw casino floor sprawl before party
Saw Cardigan take blue bomb shot
Met head barmaid Callie Duskbarrel
Watched Eliora marvel at Kreun's capture
Heard Gobu mistake Necrila for angel of death
Rax explained Moonshine's drink was a free trust stimulant.
Callie warned Rax and Moonshine that Marlo was coming down for Beltias.
The cyphermage girl recognized Gobu as Marlo's hired goblin.
Gobu inserted a coin into the brass vending machine.
Gobu received a moderate healing potion and a dark green mystery potion.
Callie said Moonshine had been fired for being drunk on shift.
Necrila explained she was sent to watch over Elias Tammerhawk.
Marlo arrived on the casino floor.
Marlo confronted Beltias Kreun in chains on his casino floor.
Necrila introduced herself as a void shell named Necrila.
Necrila asked to be allowed to deliver Kreun's fate.
Moonshine accepted Rax as leader if everyone got paid.
Cardigan talked about having Eldamon fight someone.
Cardigan introduced herself to a newcomer and their bird.
Party tasted something cheesy and heard scratching noises.
GM asked if the party wished to move up to Marlo's office.
Party agreed to go to Marlo's office.
Party moved upstairs.
Staircase was described as narrow wood and brass with paintings of burning ships.
Marlo's clockwork hand ticked on the bannister ahead.
Sounds of the club grew quieter.
Party went down a hallway at the top of the staircase.
Party found a steel reinforced door at the end of the hallway.
Davy Crab Basket stood next to the steel door.
Davy opened the door.
Party entered Marlo's office.
Party saw maps of Riddleport and trade routes on the wall.
Party saw the Cyphergate through the transparent stone window.
Marlo said they should talk business.
Necrila asked about the captured crime lord's fate and her father's business.
Filiaur checked the wanted poster for a reward.
Marlo presented bounty posts for Beltias Kreun.
Marlo pitched his plan to make the city safer.
Necrila shook hands with Marlo on hearing his deal.
Marlo offered 10 gold a week standard pay to the group.
Marlo tasked the group with killing Anger to earn the job.
Kyomi introduced herself and Ridge to the group.
Filiaur signed the contract.
Marlo shook hands with the party.
Marlo told the group to play nice.
The group finished signing contracts.
Marlo asked how to prepare for Anger.
Marlo offered the armoury and shop for preparation.
The party gathered at a casino table to plan.
Cardigan described a stitched dragon and gnome soul origin.
Cardigan declared the group the Heroes of Riddleport.
Xharyies approached the table and asked to join.
Cardigan said Marlo wanted Anger killed tomorrow.
Rax left to head home to restock supplies.
GM asked Rax where to go and what to do.
The party went across the room and into the shop.
Mira Ashvane and Davy Crab-Basket came out from behind the counters.
Filiaur pulled out treasures to part with.
Mira examined the sailing charts and described them as living cartography.
Davy appraised the silver cutlery set and offered five-and-twenty gold to fence it.
Davy sold the requested items at standard prices.
Davy gave Anthony a switchsythe.
Anthony said prep work was done and urged to move.
The GM proposed sleep-skipping to tomorrow.
A gnomish woman behind a paperwork-covered desk asked about an attack.
A young server tripped in front of Davy and apologized.
Tater tells Rin his shoes will slip too much and that he should change them.
Cardigan asks for help earning coin, saying they now work for Marlo after taking a big bounty.
Rin's shadow rises as a separate figure and swears at someone, and Rin covers its mouth.
Cardigan points at the big chest and says the wizard may try to rob it.
Cardigan explains the plan: the wizard comes in tomorrow to rob the place and will be killed on sight.
Cardigan says she is going to sleep and will see them tomorrow.
The party sleeps in a room with several rows of bunk beds.
Shadow Rin lunges at the goblin who banged the pots, shouting at it to shut up.
The goblin yelps, nearly drops its lantern and scurries off.
Tater throws a fan at the goblin, annoyed by the noise.
Shadow Rin dodges the thrown fan and slips back under Rin, who leaves the bunkhouse.
Cardigan greets Filiaur and asks if she is ready for the wizard.
The party is at the Silver Succubi on the morning of Day 2.
The big chest in the middle of the main room is open and holds about 10,000 silver pieces.
Itchy Brimstone, an imp in an iron cage above the chest, greets the party.
Marlo says the Kiss the Succubus tournament is tonight and that the wizard may attend.
Marlo hands the party rings of sigil, the Silver Kiss curse mark.
Marlo says he will move money to the vault tonight and the floor is theirs while he is down there.
Rin checks each guest at the door, politely and apologetically, and wears the ring.
The character stands with the orc Davy Crab-Bucket.
Filiaur plans to enter the tournament, watch for cheaters, and use the message cantrip to warn staff.
Rin whispers to Davy and asks if he has seen anything weird.
Davy says Riddleport is full of weird people and points out a man with a moving shadow.
Rin insists shadows move all the time, and the shadow flips the bird at Davy.
Grudge takes the party's names at the tournament table, deals the opening hand, and asks Filiaur to report any palmed cards.
Anxious tells Marlo she has not picked up anything from any guests yet.
Filiaur will enter with the casino chips the party got from Beltias.
Rax enters the Silver Succubi in plain clothes and a slightly oversized eyepatch after a messenger said the others had finished preparations early.
Ryder takes up his post at the door as the resident muscle and turns away street urchins with a growl.
Miracle Max pushes through the doors with his backpack and checks the wards on the Big Book of Miracles.
Necrila stands near the imp, and the imp senses a being far stronger than Necrila watching him.
Davy warns Rin that the shadow is probably some kind of curse and that he should be wary.
Cardigan fails to recognize Rax at first, then realizes who he is and mocks his eyepatch.
Grudge recognizes Beltias's chips, drops them into his lockbox, and remarks that they keep finding their way back to the house.
Anxious holds up four Potency Crystals she made as extra trinkets for the party.
Miracle Max notices many players in the tournament hall acting shady and decides to watch.
Rin insists the shadow is a very good shadow, which then gives a thumbs-up to Davy.
Davy hires Ryder for the door and sets out the house rule that anyone can come in.
Grudge demands Miracle Max's name, stake and bag contents, and says any glowing or ticking item is his until Max leaves.
Ryder says he has been to a few of these events and looks around the room for anyone suspicious.
Miracle Max says the bag holds medicinal supplies, experimental remedies and a roast beef sandwich, and that he leaves volatile items at home.
Rax smacks the back of Cardigan's left knee with his metal arm and tells her to stop the fake pirate talk and get to business.
Itchy the imp goes silent and presses against the far bars of his cage after Necrila steps under the birdcage.
Necrila tells Itchy in Infernal that he may seek the oracle to improve his position once free of his debt.
Marlo tells Anxious to give the four violet crystals to anyone who wants one, warning that trouble is coming soon.
Miracle Max sees Davy, Grudge, Marlo and the poppet exchange nods, and notices a sailor at the bar with the same full mug as an hour ago.
Miracle Max decides the nods are either a greeting ritual or a small operation behind the house's back, and grins.
